To: jhsigh36@dmail.com
From: emmaj.onlinecourses@dmail.com
Date: 08/17/2025
Subject: You're in!
Dear Mr. Singh,
Your registration for the online coding course, which begins on October 5th at 9:00 AM, is complete. Login details will be sent a day before the course begins. If you would like to cancel your registration, let us know by October 3rd.
Best regards,
Emma Johnson

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the e-mail?

options.A: To cancel registration for a course
options.B: To confirm registration for a course
options.C: To provide information about a course
options.D: To request payment for a course

questions.analysis: What is the main purpose of the e-mail? 原文依据：Your registration for the online coding course... is complete. 您的在线编程课程注册已完成。 (A) 取消课程注册 → 错误 (B) 确认课程注册 → 正确 (C) 提供课程相关信息 → 错误 (D) 要求支付课程费用 → 错误

questions.stem: When will Mr. Singh receive login details?
